newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq holds on to gains, ends higher for week.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq holds on to gains, ends higher for week.

text.p: Nasdaq shares held on to their three-day winning streak, while the Dow industrials slipped late in afternoon Friday.

The Nasdaq composite index gained 8.83 points, or 0.64 percent, for an unofficial close of 1379.85. The Dow industrials shed 11 points, or 0.16 percent, in late profit taking to close unofficially at at 6813. The long-bond gained almost a point, up 29/32 to 6.80 percent. Traders said that for much of the day, stocks tracked a rally in the bond market, which was spurred by economic data that suggested inflation in the fourth quarter was lower than expected.
Traders also said activity was moderate Friday ahead of next week's Federal open Market Committee meeting, although many on Wall Street expect the Federal Reserve to hold interest rates steady.

Blue Chip technology stocks built on Thursday's rally, with Intel Corp gaining 2-1/8 to 162-1/4 and Cisco Systems Inc increased 2-1/4 to 69-3/4. Oracle Corp gained 1-3/8 to 38-7/8. Winners beat losers 2338 to 1940 on volume of 693 million shares.
